Refer to the [overview section](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/cms/hubdb#filtering-and-sorting-table-rows) for detailed filtering and sorting options.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve payment accounts status
summary: Retrieve the status of payment accounts in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides information about the account's ability to transact and payout, its enrollment state, when or if it has transacted last, and the types of payment processors it is eligible for. Use this to monitor and manage your payment account's operational status.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve payment links
summary: Retrieve a list of payment links from your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter and sort payment links based on various criteria such as creation and update timestamps. It supports pagination and can include archived payment links if specified.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Create a payment link
summary: Create a new payment link in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to specify various attributes for the payment link, such as accepted payment methods, currency, and additional form fields. The payment link can be configured for one-time use and can also collect shipping and billing addresses. This operation requires a valid JSON request body. Some defaults will be applied if no value provided.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete a payment link
summary: Delete a specific payment link in your HubSpot account. This operation is irreversible and will remove the payment link identified by the provided ID. Use this endpoint to manage and clean up payment links that are no longer needed.

exclusionReason: Mandatory exclusion. Payment-link deletion stays unavailable in every tool path.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update a payment link
summary: Update a payment link by ID.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve price books
summary: Retrieve a list of price books available in your HubSpot account. This endpoint supports pagination and can return archived price books if specified. It is useful for accessing and managing pricing information across different products and services.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Create a price book
summary: Create a new price book in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define custom properties, a name, and supported currencies for the price book. A successful request will return the URL of the newly created resource.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete a price book
summary: Delete a specific price book from your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This operation will permanently remove the price book and its associated data, making it unavailable for future use.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve a price book
summary: Retrieve a specific price book by its unique identifier in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about a price book, including its status and supported currencies. It can be useful for managing and reviewing pricing strategies within your commerce system.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update a price book
summary: Update an existing price book in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify details such as the name, description, supported currencies, and custom properties of a price book. It is useful for keeping your price book information up to date with the latest changes.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Activate a price book
summary: Activate a specific price book in your HubSpot account. This operation changes the status of the price book to active, allowing it to be used in transactions and other operations. Ensure that the price book ID is correct before activation.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Deactivate a price book
summary: Deactivate a specific price book in your HubSpot account. This action changes the status of the price book to inactive, making it unavailable for use in transactions. Use this endpoint when you need to temporarily or permanently disable a price book without deleting it.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve price book items
summary: Retrieve a list of items associated with a specific price book in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to paginate through the items and specify which properties to include in the response. It is useful for managing and viewing the details of products linked to a particular price book.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Add a product to a price book
summary: Add new items to a specified price book in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to associate products with a price book by providing the necessary product details. It is useful for managing and updating the contents of your price books efficiently.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Archive price book items
summary: Archive multiple items within a specified price book in a single batch operation. This endpoint is useful for managing large sets of price book items that need to be archived simultaneously, streamlining the process and reducing the number of individual requests.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Add products to a price book
summary: Create multiple items in a specified price book in a single batch operation. This endpoint is useful for efficiently adding a large number of items to a price book, reducing the need for multiple individual requests. The operation returns a batch response indicating the success or failure of each item creation.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update price book items
summary: Update multiple items in a specified price book in a single batch operation. This endpoint allows for efficient updates of price book items, making it useful for managing large sets of data within a price book. The operation returns a batch response indicating the success or failure of each item update.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete a price book item
summary: Remove a specific item from a price book in your HubSpot account. This operation is irreversible and will permanently delete the item identified by the given priceBookItemId from the price book specified by priceBookId.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve a price book item
summary: Retrieve a specific item from a price book using its unique identifiers. This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about a particular item within a specified price book, including its properties and archived status if applicable.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update a price book item
summary: Update a specific item within a price book in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify details such as pricing, billing frequency, and custom properties for the specified item. Ensure that the item is identified correctly by its unique priceBookId and priceBookItemId.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Validate a price book
summary: Validate a specific price book in your HubSpot account. This endpoint checks the integrity and correctness of the price book identified by the given priceBookId. Use this to ensure that the price book meets all necessary criteria before proceeding with further operations.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: List channel accounts
summary: Retrieve a list of channel accounts associated with your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter results by channel ID, inbox ID, and other criteria. It's useful for managing and reviewing the channel accounts linked to your conversations.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve channel account
summary: Retrieve details of a specific channel account in your HubSpot account using the unique channelAccountId. This endpoint is useful for accessing information about a particular channel account, including its archived status.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: List Channels
summary: Retrieve a list of channels in your HubSpot account. This endpoint supports pagination and sorting, allowing you to manage large sets of data effectively. Use this endpoint to get an overview of all available channels.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve channel
summary: Retrieve details of a specific channel in your HubSpot account using the channel's unique identifier. This endpoint is useful for accessing channel-specific information, which can be used for managing or analyzing communication channels.

summary: Retrieve a list of inboxes in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to paginate through results and sort them as needed. It can also filter to include only archived inboxes.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve inbox
summary: Retrieve details of a specific inbox within your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to access information about the inbox, including whether it is archived. It is useful for managing and organizing conversations within different inboxes.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve threads
summary: Retrieve a list of conversation threads from the specified inboxes. This endpoint allows filtering by associated contact or ticket, thread status, and other parameters. It supports pagination and sorting to help manage large sets of data effectively.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete thread
summary: Delete a specific conversation thread in your HubSpot account. This operation removes the thread identified by the threadId from the system. Use this endpoint to manage and clean up conversation threads that are no longer needed.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve thread
summary: Retrieve details of a specific conversation thread using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to access information about the thread, including its properties and associations. It is useful for fetching thread details for further processing or display.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update thread
summary: Update the details of a specific conversation thread in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify the status or other attributes of the thread identified by the threadId. It is useful for managing the state of conversation threads, such as marking them as open or closed.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete Assignee
summary: Remove the assignee from a specific conversation thread in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful when you want to unassign a thread from a user, making it available for reassignment or indicating that it no longer requires a specific assignee.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update assignee
summary: Assign a specific actor to a conversation thread in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to update the assignee for a given thread, which can be useful for managing workload distribution among team members.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve messages
summary: Retrieve messages from a specific conversation thread in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to access all messages associated with a given thread, which can be useful for reviewing conversation history or analyzing communication patterns.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Create a new message within a specific thread in your HubSpot account. scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Update the details of a specific task series in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify properties and series configurations for the task identified by the taskId. Use this to adjust task scheduling or update task-related information.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete data source
summary: Delete a data source in HubSpot Data Studio. This operation is used to remove a specific data source identified by its ID. Ensure that the data source is no longer needed before deletion, as this action cannot be undone.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Retrieve detailed information about a specific data source in HubSpot Data Studio. This endpoint provides details such as the data source's name, type, creation date, and the status of the last data ingestion. It is useful for developers who need to access and manage data sources programmatically.

title: Update data source

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Get all event definitions
summary: Retrieve a list of event definitions available in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to search and filter event definitions based on various criteria, such as search strings and pagination options. It is useful for managing and understanding the different event types that are tracked within your account.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Create an event definition
summary: Create a new behavioral event definition in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define the structure and properties of a new behavioral event, which can then be used to track specific user actions or behaviors. The request body must include the necessary event details and property definitions.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete an event definition
summary: Delete a specific event definition in your HubSpot account using the event's unique name. This operation is useful for removing outdated or incorrect event definitions that are no longer needed.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Get an event definition
summary: Retrieve the definition of a specific behavioral event in your HubSpot account by providing the event name. This endpoint returns detailed information about the event type, including its properties and associations.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update an event definition
summary: Update the definition of a specific behavioral event in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify the properties and templates associated with the event. The eventName path parameter identifies the event to be updated.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Create an event property
summary: Create a new property for a specified event definition in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define custom properties associated with a particular event, enhancing the tracking and analysis of behavioral events. The request must include a JSON body with the necessary property details.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete an event property
summary: Delete a specific property from an event definition in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful when you need to remove obsolete or incorrect properties from an event definition. Ensure that the event and property names are accurately specified to avoid unintended deletions.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update an event property
summary: Update a specific property of a behavioral event definition in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify the details of an existing property associated with a given event. Use this endpoint to keep your event properties up-to-date with the latest information.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve event types
summary: Retrieve a list of event type names. You may use these event types to query the API for event occurrences of a desired type.

title: Retrieve an app's feature flags
summary: Retrieve all feature flags associated with a specific application in your HubSpot account. This endpoint is useful for developers who need to manage or audit feature flags for their applications. It requires the application ID to identify which application's flags to list.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete an app's feature flag
summary: Delete a feature flag in an app.  For example, delete the `hs-release-app-cards` flag after all accounts have been migrated.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve a feature flag
summary: Retrieve the current status of the app's feature flags. No request body is included.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Set an app's feature flag
summary: Set a feature flag for an app. For example, update the `hs-hide-crm-cards` flag's `defaultState` to `ON` to hide classic CRM cards from new installs.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Retrieve a list of HubSpot accounts with an account-level flag setting for the specified app. No request body is included.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Delete an account-level flag state for multiple HubSpot accounts at once. Use this endpoint to manage flag exposure for groups of HubSpot accounts.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Set the portal flag state for multiple HubSpot accounts at once. Use this endpoint to manage flag exposure for groups of HubSpot accounts.

summary: Delete an account-level flag state for a specific HubSpot account. No request body is included.

summary: Retrieve the account-level flag state of a specific HubSpot account.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Set an account flag state
summary: Specify an account-level flag state for a specific HubSpot account.

summary: Import a file asynchronously from a specified URL into the HubSpot file manager. This endpoint allows you to specify various parameters such as access level, duplicate validation strategy, and whether to overwrite existing files. The operation is processed asynchronously, and a task locator is returned to check the status of the import.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Check import status
summary: Retrieve the status of an asynchronous file import task using the task ID. This endpoint provides information about the current state of the task, such as whether it is pending, processing, canceled, or complete.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Search files
summary: Search for files in the HubSpot account using various filters and criteria. This endpoint allows you to specify multiple query parameters to narrow down the search results based on properties like creation date, size, type, and more. It supports pagination and sorting to manage large sets of data effectively.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Search folders
summary: Search for folders in the HubSpot file manager using various query parameters to filter results. This endpoint allows you to retrieve folders based on specific criteria such as creation date, update date, folder name, and parent folder IDs. It supports pagination and sorting to help manage large sets of data efficiently.

title: Update folder properties by folder ID
summary: Update the details of a specific folder in the file manager by providing the folder's unique identifier. This operation allows you to modify folder attributes such as its name or parent folder ID.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve forecast types
summary: Returns all forecast types configured for the portal. Forecast types define which properties are used to calculate forecasts. This endpoint is useful for retrieving the different forecast configurations available in your HubSpot account, allowing you to understand how forecasts are generated based on various properties.

title: Retrieve a forecast type
summary: Retrieve a specific forecast type by its ID from the HubSpot account. This endpoint is useful for accessing detailed information about a particular forecast type, which defines the properties used in forecasting calculations.

title: Retrieve campaigns
summary: Retrieve a page of marketing campaigns from your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to sort, filter, and paginate through campaigns, making it useful for managing and analyzing your marketing efforts.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Create a campaign
summary: Create a campaign with the specified properties and receive a copy of the object, including its ID. Note that the 'hs_goal' property is deprecated and will be ignored if provided.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve asset types
summary: List all supported campaign asset types. This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of asset types that can be used in campaigns, which is useful for understanding the available options when creating or managing campaign assets.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Batch archive campaigns
summary: Delete a batch of campaigns using their identifiers. This endpoint allows you to efficiently remove multiple campaigns at once, streamlining the process of managing campaign data. It is particularly useful for cleaning up outdated or unnecessary campaigns in bulk.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Batch create campaigns
summary: Create a batch of marketing campaigns with specified properties. This endpoint allows for the creation of multiple campaigns in a single request. Note that the 'hs_goal' property is deprecated and will be ignored if included in the request.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Batch retrieve campaigns
summary: Retrieve a batch of campaigns using specified parameters. This endpoint allows you to filter campaigns by date range and select specific properties to include in the response. It is useful for obtaining detailed information about multiple campaigns at once.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Batch update campaigns
summary: Update a batch of campaigns with the specified properties. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple campaigns in a single request. Note: The 'hs_goal' property is deprecated and will be ignored if provided.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Clone a campaign
summary: Clone a campaign identified by sourceCampaignGuid in the request body. The cloned campaign will have its own GUID and the provided properties. Asset cloning is performed asynchronously. Use the clone-status endpoint to check progress.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve clone status
summary: Check the status of an asynchronous campaign clone operation. The campaignGuid path parameter should be the GUID of the new campaign returned by the clone endpoint.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete a campaign
summary: Delete a specified campaign from the system. This operation will remove the campaign identified by the given campaignGuid from your HubSpot account.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Retrieve details of a specific marketing campaign identified by its internal ID. This endpoint allows you to access campaign information and associated assets. It is useful for obtaining campaign data for analysis or reporting purposes. If the properties to be returned are not defined with the 'properties' query parameter, the response will include an empty properties map.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Perform a partial update of a campaign identified by the specified ID. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will result in a 400 error. scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Remove asset
summary: Disassociate an asset from a specified campaign. This operation removes the link between the asset and the campaign, effectively detaching the asset from the campaign's context.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Add asset
summary: Associate an asset with a specific campaign. This operation links an asset of a specified type and ID to a campaign identified by its unique campaignGuid. It is useful for organizing and managing campaign assets within HubSpot.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Add budget item
summary: Add a new budget item to the specified campaign. This endpoint allows you to associate financial allocations with a campaign, enabling better tracking and management of campaign budgets.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve budget details
summary: Retrieve detailed budget and spending information, including totals, for a specific marketing campaign. This endpoint provides insights into the financial aspects of a campaign, helping users to manage and analyze budget allocations and spending patterns effectively.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Delete budget item
summary: Delete a specific budget item by its ID from a campaign. This operation is useful for removing budget allocations that are no longer needed or were added in error.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve budget item
summary: Retrieve a specific budget item associated with a campaign using its unique budget ID. This endpoint is useful for accessing detailed information about a particular budget item within a campaign, allowing for review and analysis of budget allocations.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update budget item
summary: Update a specific budget item by ID within a marketing campaign. This endpoint allows you to modify the details of a budget item associated with a campaign, identified by its unique campaignGuid and budgetId. Use this to adjust budget allocations or update budget-related information for a campaign.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve contact IDs
summary: Fetch the list of contact IDs for the specified campaign and contact type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve contact information associated with a particular campaign, filtered by the type of contact. It supports pagination and date filtering to manage large sets of data effectively.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve metrics
summary: Fetch the metrics of a specific marketing campaign using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to gather insights into campaign performance over a specified date range.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve revenue report
summary: Fetch revenue attribution report data for a specific campaign. This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed revenue attribution metrics, which can be filtered by attribution model and date range. This data is useful for analyzing the financial impact of marketing campaigns.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Create spend item
summary: Create a new campaign spend item for a specified campaign. This endpoint allows you to add financial details related to campaign expenditures, which can help in tracking and managing marketing budgets effectively.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Delete a specific campaign spend item by its ID. This operation is useful for managing and cleaning up spend records associated with a particular marketing campaign.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update spend item
summary: Update a specific campaign spend item by its unique spendId. This operation allows you to modify the details of an existing spend item associated with a campaign, such as its amount or description.

summary: Retrieve a list of marketing emails from your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter emails based on various criteria such as publication date, creation date, update date, and more. You can also control the number of results per page and include additional statistics or properties in the response.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Create a marketing email
summary: Create a new marketing email in your HubSpot account using the specified parameters. This endpoint allows you to define the content, settings, and other details of the email. Upon successful creation, the URL of the newly created email resource is returned.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Create an A/B test variation
summary: Create a variation of a marketing email for an A/B test. The new variation will be created as a draft. If an active variation already exists, a new one won't be created.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: This will create a duplicate email with the same properties as the original, with the exception of a unique ID.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Use this endpoint to get aggregated statistics of emails sent in a specified time span. It also returns the list of emails that were sent during the time span.

summary: Delete a marketing email by its ID

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Get the details for a marketing email.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Update a marketing email
summary: Change properties of a marketing email.

summary: This endpoint lets you obtain the variation of an A/B marketing email. If the email is variation A (master) it will return variation B (variant) and vice versa.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Reset a draft
summary: Resets the draft back to a copy of the live object.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Publish or send a marketing email
summary: If you have a Marketing Hub Enterprise account or the Transactional Email Add-On, you can use this endpoint to publish an automated email or send/schedule a regular email.

summary: Get a list of all versions of a marketing email, with each entry including the full state of that particular version. To view the most recent version, sort by the updatedAt parameter.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Retrieve an email revision
summary: Get a specific revision of a marketing email.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Restores a previous revision of a marketing email. The current revision becomes old, and the restored revision is given a new version number.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Restore to draft
summary: Restores a previous revision of a marketing email to DRAFT state. If there is currently something in the draft for that object, it is overwritten.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: If you have a Marketing Hub Enterprise account or the Transactional Email Add-On, you can use this endpoint to unpublish an automated email or cancel a regular email. If the email is already in the process of being sent, canceling might not be possible.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Create a mapping
summary: Create a new URL mapping in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define URL redirections and mappings, which can be useful for managing site navigation and SEO. The request body must include all required properties of the UrlMapping schema.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

summary: Delete a specific URL mapping in your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This operation will remove the URL mapping permanently, and it requires appropriate write and delete permissions.

title: Retrieve a mapping
summary: Retrieve a specific URL mapping by its unique identifier. This endpoint is useful for obtaining details about a particular URL mapping configuration within your HubSpot account. It requires the ID of the URL mapping as a path parameter.

An identification token returned from this API can be used to pass information about your already-authenticated visitor to the chat widget, so that it treats the visitor as a known contact. This allows support agents to recognize and assist the visitor more effectively.

scopeGroups.description: This API requires one of the following scopes:

title: Get the earliest local journal entries in batch
summary: Retrieve the earliest batch of webhook journal entries. This endpoint is useful for accessing the oldest available data in the webhook journal, allowing users to process or analyze historical webhook events. The number of entries to fetch is specified by the 'count' path parameter.

title: Get the latest local journal entries in batch
summary: Retrieve the latest batch of webhook journal entries. This endpoint allows you to specify the number of entries to fetch, providing a way to access the most recent webhook events processed by your HubSpot account.

title: Read local journal entries in batch
summary: Execute a batch read operation on the webhooks journal. This endpoint allows you to retrieve a batch of webhook journal entries by providing the necessary input data. It is useful for processing multiple records in a single request, streamlining data retrieval tasks.

title: Get the earliest local journal entry
summary: Retrieve the earliest webhook journal entries for the specified portal. This endpoint can be used to access the oldest records available in the webhook journal, which may be useful for auditing or historical analysis.

title: Get the latest local journal entry
summary: Retrieve the latest entries from the webhooks journal for the specified portal. This endpoint is useful for accessing the most recent webhook events that have been logged, allowing for real-time monitoring or debugging of webhook activities.

title: Get the next local journal entry
summary: Retrieve the next set of webhook journal entries starting from a specified offset. This endpoint is useful for paginating through large sets of webhook data, allowing you to continue from where a previous request left off.

title: Get local journal status
summary: Retrieve the status of a specific webhook journal entry using its unique status ID. This endpoint is useful for monitoring the progress or outcome of webhook journal entries, allowing you to check if an entry is pending, in progress, completed, failed, or expired.

title: Read journal entries in batch
summary: Execute a batch read operation on the webhooks journal for the specified date, 2026-03. This endpoint allows you to retrieve multiple entries from the webhooks journal in a single request, which can be useful for processing large amounts of data efficiently. Ensure that the request body is provided in the required format.

title: Get the earliest journal entry
summary: Retrieve the earliest entry from the webhooks journal for the specified portal. This endpoint is useful for accessing the first recorded webhook event in the journal, which can be helpful for auditing or debugging purposes.

title: Get journal status
summary: Retrieve the status of a specific webhook journal entry using its unique status ID. This endpoint provides detailed information about the status, including whether it is pending, in progress, completed, failed, or expired. It is useful for monitoring and managing the state of webhook journal entries.

title: Create CRM object snapshots
summary: Create a batch of CRM object snapshots in HubSpot. This endpoint is used to capture the current state of specified CRM objects for later reference or analysis. It requires a JSON payload containing the details of the CRM objects to snapshot. This operation is exempt from daily and ten-secondly rate limits.

title: Get all subscriptions
summary: Retrieve a list of webhook journal subscriptions. This endpoint provides access to subscription details without pagination, allowing you to view all current subscriptions in a single request. It is useful for managing and reviewing webhook subscriptions for your app.

title: Create or update a subscription
summary: Create a new webhook journal subscription for the specified portal. This endpoint allows you to define the actions and object types that the subscription will monitor. It requires a request body with the subscription details.

title: Create a subscription filter
summary: Create a new filter for a specific webhook subscription in the HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define conditions that determine when a webhook should be triggered. The filter is associated with a subscription identified by its ID, and the request must include the filter details.

title: Get filters for a subscription
summary: Retrieve the filters associated with a specific webhook subscription. This endpoint allows you to view the filters applied to a subscription, which can help in managing and understanding the conditions set for webhook events.

title: Delete a subscription filter
summary: Remove a specific filter from the webhooks journal subscriptions. This operation is useful for managing and cleaning up filters that are no longer needed. Once deleted, the filter cannot be recovered.

title: Get a subscription filter
summary: Retrieve a specific filter associated with a webhook journal subscription. This endpoint allows you to access the details of the filter identified by the filterId, which is useful for managing and understanding the conditions applied to webhook events.

title: Delete all subscriptions for an account
summary: Delete a webhook journal subscription for a specific portal. This operation removes the subscription associated with the given portalId, ensuring that no further webhook events are sent for this portal. Use this endpoint to manage and clean up subscriptions that are no longer needed.

title: Delete a subscription
summary: Delete a specific webhook journal subscription using its unique identifier. This operation is useful for managing and cleaning up subscriptions that are no longer needed in your HubSpot account.
